performance.note: Pipeline timing on static image frames using existing components; camera capture I/O and real-time video decode not included except model pipeline stages.

resources.note: CPU/RAM sampled in-process around frame processing; not a full-system sustained benchmark. Values depend on host load.

reliability.empty_output_note: Frames with no detections, no OCR items, and no navigation instructions in this run (depends on content/thresholds).

realtime_unmeasured.camera_to_detection_delay: NOT_MEASURED (requires live camera capture session with timestamps; not available in static/offline evaluation).
realtime_unmeasured.detection_to_voice_announcement_delay: NOT_MEASURED (requires live TTS/audio playback instrumentation; SpeechEngine uses async PowerShell/pyttsx3 calls, not benchmarked here).
realtime_unmeasured.end_to_end_accuracy: N/A (no ground-truth annotations for detection/depth/ocr events in evaluated frames).

behavior_notes.multiple_objects: Depends on frame content; YOLO returns all detections above conf (config 0.25). Not exhaustively validated without annotated multi-object dataset.
behavior_notes.objects_appearing_disappearing: Pipeline processes frames independently (no persistent tracker IDs); NavigationEngine uses cooldown-based announcement suppression (COOLDOWN_SECONDS).
behavior_notes.repeated_object_detections: NavigationEngine suppresses repeated announcements per (name,zone) within cooldown; observed by code inspection.
behavior_notes.poor_lighting_camera_movement_blur_empty: Not systematically measured (no labeled condition-specific dataset). Model performance expected to degrade; requires collected test media.
behavior_notes.model_exceptions: Handled per-frame in script; failures recorded = 0.
